name: After § 79
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 79a. Highlights the need to complete the development and ensure the deployment of the Cancer Survivor Smart Card, as established under Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan, in order to provide cancer survivors, on a voluntary basis, with secure and interoperable access to essential information on their diagnosis, treatment history, follow-up care, late effects and survivorship support;
